title: Anomaly Detection Add-on Configuration
description: Operator-tunable detector thresholds and the per-host series cap for the edge anomaly add-on. All fields optional; omitted fields keep the detector defaults (window 300, min_samples 30, n_sigma 3.0, confirm_slots 5).

min_samples.title: Minimum samples before a baseline is ready

confirm_slots.title: Consecutive breaches required to confirm an anomaly

max_series.title: Maximum tracked series per host (memory bound)

min_std_floor.title: Global absolute dispersion floor (metric units)
min_std_floor.description: Optional fleet-wide floor on the standard deviation the z-score divides by, raised before scoring so a near-constant series cannot turn a trivial wiggle into a huge z-score. Applied as a max with each series' built-in per-class floor, so it only ever tightens (never weakens a saturation gauge's safe default). Omit to keep built-in defaults (0 for non-gauges; the cpu/mem/disk gauge defaults otherwise).

min_cv.title: Global relative dispersion floor (coefficient of variation)
min_cv.description: Optional fleet-wide relative floor: the effective dispersion is at least min_cv * |mean|, so a high-magnitude series with proportionally small jitter is also tamed. Applied as a max with each series' built-in per-class floor (only ever tightens). Omit to keep built-in defaults.

metric_feed.title: Local metric feed subscription
metric_feed.description: Controls which local agent metric sources are streamed into the add-on. The default subscribes only to sysmon and SNMP metrics; ICMP and generic timeseries batches must be opted in explicitly.

checkpoint_path.title: Restart checkpoint file path
checkpoint_path.description: Local path the add-on atomically persists its per-series baselines + counter state to, so a restart re-warms instead of cold-starting (which would storm false positives while windows refill). Unset disables checkpointing.

checkpoint_max_age_secs.title: Checkpoint staleness bound (seconds)
checkpoint_max_age_secs.description: On restart, a series whose last reading is older than this is not reseeded (a stale baseline would mis-score current traffic). Default 21600 (6h).
